decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.

Condition : 2 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (12/040-01 sheet 1 of 2, 12/040-01 sheet 2 of 2 - Received 12/1/13
12/040-02A Rev.A Sheet 1 of 3, 12/040-02A Rev A Sheet 2 of 3, 12/040-02A Rev.A Sheet 3 of 3 - Received 13/3/13
Method statement revision B, March 2013 - received 18/0313
Structural Design Philosophy January 2013, revised 12/3/13 - Received 13/3/13
  ) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.
Condition : 3 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the extension hereby permitted shall match those used in the existing building.
description: Erection of a basement extension to the existing dwelling to incorporate a front ground floor lightwell and grille and a rear open lightwell and access stairs.
